description.value: Pemberton Valley Lodge is a Canadian-owned, all-suite hotel on the Sea to Sky Highway about 20 minutes north of Whistler, serving as a quieter and more affordable base for exploring the Sea to Sky corridor. The lodge features a dedicated Bike Program with complimentary bike rentals, a pool and hot tub, on-site dining, EV charging stations, and keyless room entry. It sits at the edge of a four-season outdoor adventure hub encompassing mountain biking, hiking, river rafting, and more.
